observations: Photo 0 shows a used car engine on a concrete surface, with visible components like the intake manifold, throttle body, and various hoses and wires.
The engine has green and black paint or markings on parts of the intake manifold and cylinder head.
There is a person's foot and shoe visible in the lower left corner, suggesting the photo was taken on the ground.
The engine appears to be a V6 or V8, based on the number of cylinders and components visible.
No brand or model markings are clearly visible on the engine block or components in the photo.
The seller claims it is 'Korean parts' and 'Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.'

claims.evidence: No visible brand or model markings on the engine in photo 0 to confirm Korean origin. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the photo alone.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Engine may be damaged or non-functional
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the engine running, or a close-up of the cylinder head and block for cracks or wear.

risks.risk: Engine may be from a different brand or model than claimed
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block with visible brand and model markings, or a photo of the VIN tag or part number.

risks.risk: Engine may have hidden mechanical issues (e.g., internal damage, oil leaks, worn bearings)
risks.proof: A video showing the engine being tested or a close-up of the oil pan and oil filter for signs of contamination or leaks.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine block showing brand and model markings.
Video or photo of the engine running or being tested.
Close-up of the oil pan and oil filter to check for contamination or leaks.
Photo of the VIN tag or part number if available.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
